name: Ian Pasley
blurb: Ian Pasley is YEP’s Finance Officer with over 16 years of experience managing non- profit and higher education accounting and finance. Ian believes that working with a diverse group toward completing projects for YEP partner organizations molds for our crewmembers a strong foundation for developing teamwork and leadership skills, critical thinking skills, stewardship within the community, and a lifelong appreciation for land resources and conservation. When he is not geeking out over spreadsheets, Ian enjoys being outfished by his wife, nerding out on his Xbox, or poorly picking at his guitar. He earned a BBA in Accounting from Austin Peay State University and a MBA in Organizational Management from Keller Graduate School of Business.
